ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; high-intensity pixels (white) are localized in a large patch on the left lobe and scattered in circular clusters across the right lobe.
